question: Where is museum situated within 90 kilometers along the travel path toward Holiday Inn Express & Suites Ashtabula-Geneva, Austinburg, OH from Bastion Studios, Erie, PA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE (p.tourism = 'museum' OR p.museum IS NOT NULL) AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bastion Studios%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Erie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 90000 -- 90 kilometers in meters ) AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bastion Studios%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Erie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Holiday Inn Express & Suites Ashtabula-Geneva%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Austinburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 500 -- Buffer the path by 500 meters to define "along the path" ) );
